evals.prompt: The final pose looks right. What evidence would show the result is not an artifact of one timestep or one random seed?
evals.expected_output: The response recognizes a verification request, checks the full trajectory, defines timestep/substep and repeated-seed comparisons, and uses fixed acceptance criteria.
assertions: Selects the verification skill.
Does not rely only on the final pose.
Uses sensitivity and repeated-seed evidence when applicable.
Keeps acceptance criteria fixed during comparison.

evals.prompt: A Newton 1.7 DisplayPort insertion run reports a high success rate, but some trajectories exceed the actuator travel limit or show excessive connector penetration. Verify the simulation result and state what would still be needed for a sim-to-real claim.
evals.expected_output: The response rejects task-success labels that violate physical constraints, checks complete trajectories against fixed travel and penetration bounds, reports simulation validity separately, and requires corresponding hardware evidence for sim-to-real conclusions.
assertions: Rejects nominal successes that violate actuator or penetration bounds.
Checks complete trajectories rather than aggregate success alone.
Separates simulation validity from sim-to-real validity.
Requires hardware evidence for real-world claims.

evals.prompt: Verify the SHA-256 checksum of a downloaded archive. It contains no Newton model or simulation result.
evals.expected_output: The response uses ordinary file-integrity verification and does not load a Newton simulation verification skill.
assertions: Does not read newton-verify-simulation.
Keeps the task scoped to checksum verification.
Does not invent physical acceptance criteria.

evals.prompt: I want to check a Newton rollout only for finite positions and velocities. I have no external reference trajectory. Give me a verification plan and explain what evidence I need; do not run anything.
evals.expected_output: Plans complete-trajectory finite-state checks without requiring an unrelated external reference.
assertions: Does not block finite-state verification on a missing external reference.
Describes checking all required position and velocity samples and separates proposed checks from measured results.
Does not claim parity or physical accuracy from finiteness alone.

evals.prompt: For a Newton finite-state check, may I explicitly authorize running my existing rollout to collect a missing trajectory, or does verification have to stop until I supply a separate reference? Explain the workflow without executing anything.
evals.expected_output: Allows explicitly authorized evidence collection from an existing rollout and requires references only when the claim needs comparison.
assertions: Allows an explicitly authorized run of an existing rollout to collect missing trajectory evidence.
Does not require an external reference for a finite-state claim.
Respects this request for explanation only and does not claim to have collected evidence.

evals.prompt: Create a Newton robot scene with ground contacts and a short joint motion. Pick a supported solver and implement the scene.
evals.expected_output: Handles construction through usage guidance without activating independent claim verification.
assertions: Does not activate newton-verify-simulation solely for construction.
Does not require the retired newton-build-simulation skill.

evals.prompt: My Newton model starts jittering and then explodes when the gripper touches the cube. Find the cause and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Treats the task as root-cause diagnosis and repair.
assertions: Does not activate newton-verify-simulation as the primary root-cause repair workflow.
Preserves the reported failure as the repair target.

evals.prompt: Our Newton rollout takes 80 ms per frame. Profile it and reduce the time while retaining the current trajectory tolerance.
evals.expected_output: Treats profiling and speed improvement as performance work.
assertions: Does not activate newton-verify-simulation as the primary performance workflow.
Does not require the retired newton-optimize-simulation skill.
